en_US: Hold run and move to full speed; reverse to brake. Compare short/held jumps and max-speed jump poses.
zh_CN: 按住加速和方向跑到满速，再反向刹车。比较短跳、长跳和满速跳姿态。

en_US: Jump into the block to the right or use Mushroom. Compare Small and Super; use pause/step during the transformation.
zh_CN: 向右顶问号块或点击吃蘑菇。比较小型与大型，演出期间可暂停、单帧查看。

en_US: Starts paused as Super beneath a 16 px gap. Step without crouch: stay low. Move out to stand; compare Small using the form selector.
zh_CN: 默认以大型在16px通道内暂停。松开下蹲并单帧推进：仍应蹲着；移出后站起。可切小型比较。

en_US: The enemy is to the right. Compare a stomp with side contact; hold/release jump when stomping. Change form to inspect damage and invulnerability.
zh_CN: 敌人在右侧。比较踩踏与侧面接触，踩踏时分别按住和松开跳跃；切换形态观察降级与无敌。

en_US: Starts paused on a raised platform. Walk off to the right; use F7 to count the coyote window. R restarts here.
zh_CN: 默认在高台暂停。向右走出边缘，用F7数离地窗口，在窗口内外分别起跳；R回到此处。

en_US: Starts paused in the air. Step until almost grounded; tap jump within the buffer window. Compare one frame after expiry; R repeats the fall.
zh_CN: 默认在空中暂停。单帧推进至接近地面，在缓冲窗口内按跳跃，比较超时后一帧；R重新落下。

en_US: Starts paused with 3 px overlap at the ceiling edge. Jump straight up and step. Compare correction distances 2 and 3 px; R repeats the same position.
zh_CN: 默认暂停，头顶与方块边缘重叠3px。原地跳并单帧观察，比较纠偏距离2与3px；R复现相同位置。
